name: background-doze
description: Background then force deep doze, pre-armed so force-idle lands ~0.3s after ON_STOP rather than ~2s.

steps.why: clear the stats.minimum_upload_interval_ms floor (30s default, not the 5s upload cadence). Shorter and the ON_STOP upload is refused, so the run measures the gate instead of the question.

steps.name: doze-deep
steps.why: doze needs the screen off, so it can only be applied after backgrounding; it therefore races any in-flight upload
